title: Caleb Claims Hebron as an Inheritance
description: Caleb, who remained faithful to the Lord when the other spies caused the people to lose heart, now claims the promise of Hebron as his inheritance. Although he is 85 years old and the land is inhabited by the powerful Anakim, he asks Joshua to help drive them out with the Lord's aid. Joshua blesses him and gives him Hebron, formerly known as Kirjath-Arba, as an inheritance. Thus, the land had rest from war.
